```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 18_regression_ss_df
title: >
  SS/df Quiz
questions:
  - id: sqrt_ss_df
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      What is the square root of sum of squares divided by degrees of freedom?
    options:
      - text: >
          A standard deviation or standard-error-like quantity
        correct: true
      - text: >
          A raw score
      - text: >
          A p-value
      - text: >
          The slope only
    explanation: >
      For ordinary deviations this is the standard deviation; for residuals in
      regression it becomes the standard error of the estimate.
```
